title: Image Retrieval using Scene Graphs
representation: Object instances with attributes and directed relations; grounding maps nodes to boxes
construction: Human query graph; CRF scores candidate image groundings
assumptions: Graph query supplied; learned detectors use supported vocabulary despite open annotation vocabulary
applications: Semantic image retrieval and object localization
evaluation: Retrieval rank and localization on their scene graph dataset
limitations_authors: Strong annotation supervision and sparse vocabulary coverage
limitations_our_inference: No persistent identity or action feedback
open_questions: Can relation grounding distinguish identical manipulation targets?
reading_scope: PDF representation and method sections reviewed

title: Scene Graph Generation by Iterative Message Passing
representation: Box-grounded objects and directed predicate edges
construction: Learned node/edge GRUs exchange messages to refine predictions
assumptions: Detected proposals and supervised object/predicate labels
applications: Scene graph prediction; physical support relations
evaluation: Visual Genome recall at K; NYU Depth v2 support prediction
limitations_authors: Local relationship inference can miss contextual constraints; motivates joint inference
limitations_our_inference: Closed labels and per-image inference do not supply object memory
open_questions: Which contextual relations improve a policy rather than graph recall?
reading_scope: HTML representation and method sections reviewed

title: Neural Motifs: Scene Graph Parsing with Global Context
representation: Boxes and object labels followed by directed relation predictions
construction: Staged detector and global bidirectional LSTM context; category-pair frequency baseline
assumptions: Supervised Visual Genome labels; region ordering for sequential context
evaluation: Visual Genome PredCls/SGCls/SGDet recall at K
limitations_authors: Strong label co-occurrence priors can explain substantial benchmark performance
limitations_our_inference: Graph accuracy may reflect category statistics rather than geometric evidence
open_questions: How to test grounding when object labels are identical?
reading_scope: HTML method and frequency-baseline sections reviewed

title: Action Genome: Actions as Composition of Spatio-temporal Scene Graphs
representation: Human-object attention/spatial/contact relations changing over frames
construction: Action-interval annotations and scene graph feature banks
assumptions: Charades human activities; selected frames and involved objects
applications: Action recognition; few-shot recognition; temporal graph prediction
evaluation: Charades mAP and scene graph recall at K
limitations_authors: Temporal action decomposition needs more than static image graphs
limitations_our_inference: Human-centric sparse annotations are not metric robot object tracking
open_questions: What update rate and identity evidence are needed under occlusion?
reading_scope: HTML annotation and method sections reviewed
